items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: everybody called me Hamburger Red. That's another one of my nicknames.

ctx.x: And she punished me. She didn't whip me for it. She punished me by not letting me go, and everybody left me the next day, but I told the lady next door that we were ready -- my mother was ready for her, and she called my mother on the job where she was working, and she said, I'm sorry he told you, but he didn't tell me. And she wouldn't let me go. But she begged and pleaded for me, but it didn't work.

But as I said to you before, she was as hurt for doing it, but she had to stand on her own convictions, and she knew I liked hamburgers because everybody called me Hamburger Red. That's another one of my nicknames.
